translations.web: You shall therefore obey Yahweh your God’s voice, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command you today.”
translations.bsb: You shall therefore obey the voice of the LORD your God and follow His commandments and statutes I am giving you today.”
translations.kjv: Thou shalt therefore obey the voice of the LORD thy God, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command thee this day.
translations.asv: Thou shalt therefore obey the voice of Jehovah thy God, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command thee this day.
